To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
SPPV has a local immunosuppressive effect and a systemic immunostimulating effect on macrophages.
the inactivated or attenuate sheeppox vaccine modulate the functions of macrophages, and lymphocytes in a local and systemic event.
inactivated SPPVs have the ability to induce an immune response that is different from that induced by live attenuated SPPVs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding how the virus interacts with the host's immune system and how this interaction can be used in the future to develop a safe, effective and economical vaccine for sheeppox.
the mechanisms of immune escape and immune protection that are used by sheeppoxy virus.
the basic mechanisms adopted to modulate macrophages' function and lymphocyte response to T-depend and PHA-P by SPPV.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the inactivated or attenuate SPPV is able to induce an immunostimulating response in mice, which may be the reason of its use as an effective prophylactic or meta-phylactic application in different animals species.

SPPV is a virus with immunostimulating activity that is not only restricted to the inactivated virus, and that the virus has a dual effect on the immune response, a local suppression and a systemic stimulation.
SPPV has a double-edged sword effect, it is able to suppress the host immune response locally and to stimulate it systemically.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the virus uses a double strategy to protect the host from the deleterious effects of immune system activation.
SPPV possesses a double-faced effect on host immune response, locally it is immunosuppressive and systemically it is immunostimulating.
the virus is able to induce a state of immunotolerance in the host that may be a key to understand the mechanism of reinfection.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SPPV is a good model to understand the mechanisms of immune evasion by viruses.
the inactivated or attenuating viruses can be used as a vaccine to stimulate the immune system.
SPPV has a complex and multifaceted interaction with the host immune response, which is not fully understood yet.
